role: Partial measurement-package and analytic-spectrum reference; not accepted end-to-end TPS benchmark

criteria.applicability: six-filter CR39 arrays; source-specific Mylar/Al, not Stars
criteria.failure_consequence: Species/energy-dependent attenuation can mimic source changes
criteria.needed: Measured areal thickness/composition/uncertainty and filter transmission including straggling

criteria.applicability: exact plates, scan locations, shots and image processing
criteria.failure_consequence: Cannot reproduce extraction or fit likelihood from raw counts; plotted fits are not independent observations
criteria.needed: Image stacks, pit catalogs, masks, counts and all-shot exposure/area normalization

criteria.independence_status: PDF/XML agree; this is source checking, not independent experimental validation
criteria.failure_consequence: Wrong diameter mapping can misidentify species or fabricate alpha component
criteria.needed: Authors implementation or clarified formula/parameter/coordinate conventions

criteria.applicability: CR39a versus nearby-angle TP2, same experiment
criteria.independence_status: different diagnostics, not independent campaign or identical angle
criteria.failure_consequence: Absolute inferred yields shift while spectral shape may agree
criteria.needed: Matched angle/shot mapping, scanner calibration, effective area/solid angle and covariance

criteria.applicability: specific detector lots, etch history and image processing
criteria.independence_status: calibration and application not interchangeable; no new holdout
criteria.failure_consequence: Rare alpha signal can be confused with proton/heavy-ion tails
criteria.needed: Lot-specific calibration, tails/overlap/background model and independent controls

criteria.applicability: same grade/etch/readout and actual incident energy at detector
criteria.needed: Actual at-detector calibration points/distributions; nominal8MeV accelerator setting does not establish7.5MeV after RBS losses
